title: Charging by Induction Simulation
description: An interactive step-by-step MicroSim demonstrating how objects can be charged through electrostatic induction without direct contact. Shows electron redistribution in conductors when a charged rod approaches.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: electrostatic induction
electric charge
conductors
electron mobility
charge distribution
physics
electrostatics
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of charging by induction
Explore charging by induction through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of charging by induction to solve problems
Test understanding of charging by induction through interactive exercises
